posts.text: A month ago I built a small wildlife pond in my backyard, and today I noticed a mushroom growing in between the liner and stones! This pond has already helped dozens of species of bird, insect, and small mammal grab a drink during these seemingly endless droughts and heatwaves.  It cost around $400 between the liner, pump, plumbing, solar panel, terrestrial plants, aquatic plants, rocks, aquatic soil, compost, and mulch.
